result.summary: The page mostly looks fine, but the heart/favorite icon on the second 'Popular right now' pizza card has low contrast with its dark circular background and there is an inconsistency in the heart icon background styling between the two cards (white circle vs dark circle).

issues.description: The heart icon background on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card is white/light, while the heart icon background on the pizza card below it is dark, creating inconsistent visual styling between similar card elements.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon button background color/opacity across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.

issues.description: The promotional banner text 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' is slightly small and low-contrast against the green background, making it harder to read quickly.
issues.suggestion: Increase font size or contrast slightly for better readability of promotional terms.
